title: Verified capability and isolation
contract: With trusted authorization checking, only authorized callers can change the protected value.
scope: Validation flag, caller authorization and protected values 0..2; admission trusted check enabled.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: A granted write implies caller has authority.
Authorized caller increments; unauthorized caller leaves protected value unchanged.
